# Wiele Property

Wiele Property is a Malta property-marketing and introductions platform under the Wiele Group brand, led by Jonathan Landman. Focus: property sales marketing, not rentals. Sales documentation is handled by appropriately licensed practitioners.

There are currently no advertised properties. Location photographs are not properties offered for sale.
